points: \item Implemented deep learning models using TensorFlow and PyTorch for 3D reconstruction and object recognition, improving scene understanding accuracy by ~20% and enabling AI-driven vision systems for R&D applications.

\item Built hybrid ML workflows for 2D/3D visual data processing, enhancing feature extraction and geometric modeling for image segmentation, depth estimation, and motion tracking in production environments.

\item Developed evaluation pipeline to assess model performance across hundreds of computer vision scenarios, ensuring production-ready reliability for deployment in multidisciplinary engineering teams with rigorous testing.

\item Optimized deep learning training workflows through data preprocessing, augmentation, and model evaluation, reducing training time by ~80% and enabling faster deployment of vision systems for challenging 3D modeling projects.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for 3D data validation (point clouds, meshes, depth maps), reducing data quality issues by 25% while maintaining model performance and improving visualization accuracy.

\item Built a National ID authentication system using YOLO object detection, MiDaS depth estimation, and GAN-generated synthetic samples for robust hologram verification, demonstrating hands-on experience in computer vision and 3D image processing for security applications.
